g.title: ICIC_QSP
g.text: Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor-Induced Colitis — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
CTLA-4 blockade depletes the denominator · PD-1 blockade saturates the numerator · the colon spends a 2.5x absorptive reserve
before the first loose stool · and every rescue drug trades colitis control against the tumour in proportion to how systemic it is

g.title: cluster_host
g.text: 1. Host susceptibility — the setpoint that exists before the first infusion

g.title: cluster_micro
g.text: 2. Lumen — antigen drive and butyrate, the two opposite exports of the microbiome

g.title: cluster_prime
g.text: 3. Draining lymph node — CD28/CTLA-4 competition sets how many clones are licensed

g.title: cluster_icipk
g.text: 4. Checkpoint inhibitor PK/PD — a saturated numerator and an unsaturated denominator

g.title: cluster_eff
g.text: 5. Colonic lamina propria — the numerator, and the resident pool that outlives the drug

g.title: cluster_reg
g.text: 6. Regulatory arm — the denominator that anti-CTLA-4 removes

g.title: cluster_cyto
g.text: 7. Cytokine network — IFN-γ sets the programme, TNF-α executes it

g.title: cluster_epi
g.text: 8. Epithelium — a regenerative flux balance; the barrier is the difference of two large numbers

g.title: cluster_water
g.text: 9. Water & electrolytes — a 2.5x reserve, therefore a censored symptom

g.title: cluster_rescue
g.text: 10. Rescue therapy — depth in the cascade sets onset; gut-selectivity sets oncological cost

g.title: cluster_comp
g.text: 11. Complications — and the loop by which severity lowers the exposure of its own antidote

g.title: cluster_end
g.text: 12. Endpoints — the censored symptom, the uncensored biomarkers, and the tumour

g.title: RESERVE
g.text: ⇒ grade is a late, lossy instrument

g.title: IFX_PK
g.text: CL 0.4 L/d · V 5.5 L · t½ 8-10 d
